burst_event_order.note: Fire event/broadcast precedes ammo-consumption failure; truncated burst can have more remote fire events than projectiles.

client_prediction.observed_run18: 258 successful local API calls/trigger/fire events; 257 observer trigger/fire events and 257 projectile joins on each client; server inventory consumption 257.
client_prediction.source_interpretation: Both versions emit local trigger before scheduled packet and local fire callbacks without an acceptance acknowledgment. The server independently checks cooldown, timestamp validity and heat before broadcasting accepted trigger events; ClientMessagePlayerShoot ignores the returned ShootResult.
client_prediction.limit: Local events are predictions, not acknowledgments. The exact reason for the extra local event in run18 is unconfirmed; no baseline runtime, visual/audio, latency or packet-rejection parity is inferred.
